name_input: M/s IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED; IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PVT LTD; IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES LIMITED; IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED; M/s IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED; IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PVT LTD; IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No dated export bill-of-lading found. ImportKey company page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/iris-global-services-private-limited) reports "Total Shipments 790 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 2 Known counterparties", but every visible row is INBOUND to India, e.g. "2026-02-28 | RUCKUS WIRELESS LLC | IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED | WIRELESS ACCESS POINT-901-R650-NC00 ... | SINGAPORE, Vietnam | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 85176990 | 7801647". The only outbound-looking entries are aggregated supplier-side rows under the 'Buyers' tab — "125 | SYNERGY TECH PVT LTD | ... IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED | Biratnagar, NEPAL" and "2 | TYAX (PVT) LTD. | IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED | NO. 22/8/6 NO. 22 TEMPLE ROAD NAWALA SRI LANKA-10250" — with no date, no HS code and no B/L number, so they cannot be counted as export shipment records. Source counter: page claims 790 shipments / 2 trading partners; rows actually seen with date+destination+HS+B/L = 5, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved. web_search was unavailable during this run (searx connection refused) and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403, so no domestic-supply record was read. Import activity at Delhi Air Cargo (HS 85176990 WLAN controllers/access points, HS 85411000 diodes) is inbound only and is not evidence of domestic supply.
note: Role appears to be importer/distributor of networking gear (Ruckus Wireless, Voyager Trading Partners) into India, not an exporter. Declared HS codes 844331 (multifunction printers/copiers) and 847150 (processing units) do NOT match the observed customs HS codes 85176990 and 85411000 — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the actual codes should be recorded as 85176990 / 85411000. Export status is 'declared_only' strictly because two undated counterparty rows (Nepal, Sri Lanka) hint at possible outbound trade but carry no shipment-level proof; no confirmed export shipment with date, destination, HS and B/L was found. Domestic supply: no traces of supply found in the sources reachable in this run — status unknown, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the sources read). No CIN/PAN verified.
